newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan LDP says will not change '96/97 extra budget.
newsitem.headline: Japan LDP says will not change '96/97 extra budget.

text.p: Koichi Kato, secretary-general of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP), said on Wednesday that the party does not plan to revise the proposed 2.67 trillion yen supplementary budget for the current fiscal year.

He made the remarks at a news conference following media reports that Japan's three main opposition parties plan to ask jointly for a substantial cut in the total expenditure planned in the supplementary budget.
Opposition party officials have said the supplementary budget, which calls for some spending on public works projects, runs counter to the government's effort to reduce its fiscal deficit.
